n: infiNET EX® Wireless Relay/Digital Input Control Module (INET-IOEX-RYIO)
d: INET-IOEX-RYIO infiNET EX® Wireless Relay/Digital Input Control Module

specs.label: RF Transceiver
specs.value: infiNET EX 2-way RF, 2.4 GHz ISM Channels 11-26 (2400 to 2483.5 MHz), default channel 15; IEEE 802.15.4 compliant

specs.value: 150 ft (46 m) indoor, 250 ft (76 m) outdoor, to nearest mesh network device(s); subject to site-specific conditions and individual device capabilities

specs.value: Input: 100-240 Volts AC, 50/60Hz; Output: 1.2 Amps @ 5 Volts DC; Model: PW-0510WUL
